notes: The object suffix on וַיַּחְשְׁבֶהָ is realized by the subject *she* of the recast complement clause (rule 18); the לְ of לְשִׁכֹּרָה is left unrepresented (rule 40).
The clause writes both חַנָּה and the resumptive הִיא and the ASV renders both, so rule 20's unrendered-resumptive case does not arise.
